title: Scheduled reminders never re-send to a recipient on retry
goal: A daily reminder job that is retried after an infrastructure error sends only to the recipients it had not reached yet.
why: Found by R117 (2026-10-15): process*ForTenant now lets infrastructure errors reach the runner, which releases the job claim and retries the whole job, so recipients already messaged earlier in the loop would get a second SMS/WhatsApp/email (cost and annoyance).
steps: From R110 (2026-10-15): the reminder jobs built in backend/src/cron/auto-reminders.ts (birthday, invoice, visa/passport, missing documents, trip reminders) enqueue SMS/email jobs with field names the sms-queue and email-queue consumers do not read and without tenantId, so they are neither metered nor able to reach a provider. Fix the job shape to match the consumers (read backend/src/queues/sms-queue.ts and email-queue.ts), add tenantId, and route them through the R110 metering (meterUsage before send, skipped_allowance at the cap). Add a test that each reminder type produces a job the consumer actually sends.

Add a per-recipient claim keyed by (tenant_id, job, period_key, recipient key) — reuse cron_job_runs with a recipient-scoped key or add a small tenant table (next free tenant migration; regenerate the bundle) — written before each send with INSERT OR IGNORE and checked so a retried job skips recipients already claimed.
A send that fails for a per-recipient reason keeps its claim marked failed (not retried automatically); an infrastructure error before the send releases only that recipient's claim.
Prune recipient claims older than 14 days in the daily platform pruning job.
migrations: tenant: next free number, only if cron_job_runs cannot carry the recipient key
tests: retry after an infrastructure error mid-loop sends exactly once to every recipient
a per-recipient failure is not retried
acceptance: Every reminder type produces a queue job the consumer sends (through the metering), with the tenant id (test).
A daily job that fails on recipient 3 of 5 and is retried sends one message to each of the 5 recipients in total (test).
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # >= merged count
notes: Metering from R110 must count each recipient once; do not consume allowance for skipped recipients.
